## 9. Podcast Highlights

**Date:** 2026-05-11  
**Link:** [The New Jobs AI Will Create](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WhAAKxPlMhw)  
**Summary:** The episode argued that AI labor-market analysis is overly concentrated on displacement and underweights demand expansion: lower prices, broader access, reduced complexity, and continuous service availability may create new work categories.  
**Available now:** Conceptual analysis only; no cited tool, paper, or deployable workflow provided in the supplied transcript.  
**How to use it:** Apply the framework when evaluating AI exposure in a sector: identify where AI lowers cost, removes access constraints, simplifies complex systems, or enables continuous service, then map likely new human roles around supervision, personalization, compliance, and service expansion.  
**Why it matters:** Useful as a scenario-planning lens for workforce strategy, but not actionable as a technical workflow.
